hero.h1: Gas Line Installation in Lincoln Park, Chicago
hero.sub: A gas range in a renovated kitchen, a new gas fireplace or a line to the rooftop deck grill. Our licensed plumbers size, run and test gas lines in Lincoln Park homes. Our office is on Diversey Parkway.

blocks.h2: How We Install a Gas Line
Gas Line Projects in Lincoln Park
blocks.intro: City renovations often mean new gas work in old buildings.

items.body: Moving the range means a new branch line.
Gas fireplaces are a popular upgrade. See [gas fireplace service](/chicago-lincoln-park/gas-fireplace).
Outdoor lines need protection and a shutoff.

blocks.body: Rooftop decks are common on Lincoln Park homes, and a built-in grill or fire table up there needs a gas line that's run, supported and protected properly. We plan the route from the meter, often up an exterior wall or through a chase, add a shutoff at the appliance and pressure-test the line. The City of Chicago may require a permit, and we'll handle it where it does.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of a New Gas Line
blocks.body: The route through an older building matters most, along with the distance from the meter. Rooftop decks and upper-floor kitchens take more work. City permits may apply. We plan the route and quote one flat price.

blocks.h2: Gas Line Installation Questions From Lincoln Park Homeowners

items.q: Can I switch from an electric range to gas?
items.answer: Usually. We run a new branch and install a shutoff behind the range.

items.q: Can you run gas to a rooftop deck?
items.answer: Often. It depends on the route through the building and code requirements. We'll look and explain the options.
Yes, where the city requires one for the work.

items.q: Will my meter handle a new appliance?
items.answer: We calculate the total load. If the meter or service line needs an upgrade, we'll help coordinate with Peoples Gas.

items.q: Can a roof deck line serve a fire table and a grill?
items.answer: Yes, if the line is sized for both, with a shutoff at each.

items.q: Can you run gas to a range on an upper floor?
items.answer: Yes, through a chase or wall, sized for the range.

items.q: How much does gas line installation cost in Lincoln Park?
items.preview: It depends on the run. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the length of the run, the appliance and the route. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
